key_impacts: About 14 inches of rain fell in four hours.
The Acelhuate River became a powerful torrent that ripped away bridges and obliterated homes.
30 houses were destroyed and more than 100 were damaged.
Approximately 300 people evacuated in time and no lives were lost.

key_impacts: 12 houses were completely inundated in Aragon, including a resident's home.
One resident reported losing everything she owned.
More than a million people were left homeless.
